questions.skill: Sketch graphs that show key features given in a verbal description
questions.standard_level: Algebra I. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra I, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: A ball is thrown up from a 2-m platform. It reaches its highest point, 7 m, after 1 second, and it lands on the ground after about 2.2 seconds. Sketch its height against time. Label the starting point, the maximum, and the landing time.
questions.prompt_markup:
A ball is thrown up from a 2-m platform. It reaches its highest point, 7 m, after 1 second, and it lands on the ground after about 2.2 seconds.
Sketch its height against time. Label the starting point, the maximum, and the landing time.
questions.correct_answer: A curve starting at (0, 2), rising to a peak at (1, 7), and falling to the t-axis near (2.2, 0), with those points labeled
questions.grading_note: Any correct sketch: the intercept 2, the maximum (1, 7), increasing then decreasing, and the landing time near 2.2.

figure.description: Coordinate grid with x from 0 to 3 and y from 0 to 8. x-axis label "Time (seconds)", y-axis label "Height (meters)". Nothing is plotted; the student draws on it.

questions.skill: Sketch graphs that show key features given in a verbal description
questions.standard_level: Algebra I. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra I, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: A car is worth $20,000 when new, and it loses 15% of its value each year, never reaching $0. Sketch its value for 0 to 10 years. Show the starting value and what happens as time goes on.
questions.prompt_markup:
A car is worth $20,000 when new, and it loses 15% of its value each year, never reaching $0.
Sketch its value for 0 to 10 years. Show the starting value and what happens as time goes on.
questions.correct_answer: A decreasing curve from (0, 20) that falls more slowly each year and stays above 0 (about 4 at 10 years)
questions.grading_note: Any correct sketch: intercept 20, always decreasing, curving toward but never reaching 0. 20(0.85)¹⁰ ≈ 3.9.

figure.description: Coordinate grid with x from 0 to 10 and y from 0 to 20. x-axis label "Years", y-axis label "Value (thousands of dollars)". Nothing is plotted; the student draws on it.

questions.prompt: A 50-liter tank drains at a constant rate until it is empty after 5 minutes, stays empty for 2 minutes, and then refills at a constant rate to 30 liters in 3 minutes. Sketch the volume over the 10 minutes.
questions.prompt_markup:
A 50-liter tank drains at a constant rate until it is empty after 5 minutes, stays empty for 2 minutes, and then refills at a constant rate to 30 liters in 3 minutes.

questions.correct_answer: A segment from (0, 50) to (5, 0), a horizontal segment from (5, 0) to (7, 0), and a segment from (7, 0) to (10, 30)

figure.description: Coordinate grid with x from 0 to 10 and y from 0 to 50. x-axis label "Time (minutes)", y-axis label "Volume (liters)". Nothing is plotted; the student draws on it.

questions.skill: Sketch a graph from a description
questions.prompt: You walk away from home at a steady pace for 10 minutes, rest for 5 minutes, then walk home faster in 10 minutes. Sketch your distance from home over 25 minutes.
questions.prompt_markup:
You walk away from home at a steady pace for 10 minutes, rest for 5 minutes, then walk home faster in 10 minutes.
Sketch your distance from home over 25 minutes.
questions.correct_answer: A rising segment for 0 to 10 minutes, a horizontal segment for 10 to 15, and a steeper falling segment back to 0 at 25
questions.grading_note: Any correct qualitative sketch with the three pieces in order.

figure.description: Coordinate grid with x from 0 to 25 and y from 0 to 10. x-axis label "Time (minutes)", y-axis label "Distance (blocks)". Nothing is plotted; the student draws on it.

questions.skill: Write and graph equations on labeled axes
questions.standard_level: Algebra I. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra I, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: Write an equation for the area A of a square with side s. What kind of graph does it have for s ≥ 0?
questions.prompt_markup: Write an equation for the area A of a square with side s. What kind of graph does it have for s ≥ 0?
questions.correct_answer: A = s²; half of a parabola, starting at (0, 0) and curving upward
questions.grading_note: Form required: the equation and the shape.
